name: sharelink
description: ShareLink - 基于 Pingvin Share X 二次开发的自托管文件分享平台（monorepo 脚本聚合器）

scripts.install:all: cd backend-nest && npm install && cd ../frontend-vue && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "cd backend-nest && npm run start:dev" "cd frontend-vue && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd backend-nest && npm run build && cd ../frontend-vue && npm run build
scripts.format: cd backend-nest && npm run format && cd ../frontend-vue && npm run format
scripts.lint: cd backend-nest && npm run lint && cd ../frontend-vue && npm run lint
